WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is the owner in fee of certain land,with the building and improvements thereon,located in Bronx County,New York,known as Lot 40 in Block 2925 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and commonly known as 546 East 170"h Street, Bronx, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called “Owner's Property” and said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement, being called the"Owner'sBuilding"); WHEREAS, Developer is under contract to purchase certain land, with the building and improvements thereon, located in Bronx County, New York, known as Lots 42 and 48 in Block 2925 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and commonly known as 550 East 170"h Street, Bronx, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called “Developer's Property” and said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement,being called the“Developer's Building"); WHEREAS,Developer intends to demolish the existing improvements on Developer's Property and to construct thereon a new building (such new building, as the same may be altered, modified, improved or replaced from time to time, the “New Building"); and WHEREAS,it is planned that the New Building will contain more Floor Area (as hereinafter defined) than is now permitted to be constructed on the Developer's Property pursuant to the Zoning Resolution with the result that Developer desires to make use of the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Developer's Property and the Owner's Property into a single “zoning lot” for the purpose of making available the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) in connection with the construction of the New Building; and WHEREAS,Owner desires to allow Developer to utilize the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) in the New Building and, in connection therewith, to grant to Developer certain rights and easements with respect to Owner's Property as more specifically set forth herein;
